caveats: Experimental: Paseo >=0.8.0 (SDK-tested to 0.10.0-beta.1), daemon Node >=22.19, and a separately installed official DSH with credentials.
Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 or newer (tested through 0.2.0-rc.1); plugins and DSH tools are trusted, unsandboxed code.
Resumes native DSH context without transcript replay; Paseo retains displayed history.
No raw token deltas, slash commands, steering, plans or terminal UI; real vision/MCP services are untested.
Discovery can leave empty DSH sessions; DSH profiles are authoritative and Paseo's extra system prompt is not injected.
Real macOS daemon turns passed on Paseo 0.8.0 (with restart resume) and 0.10.0-beta.1; desktop-app and native mobile UI are unverified.
